audit.summary: Major scope error in complete-pipeline unseen-domain interpretation; local arithmetic, objective and evaluation implementation issues; reported empirical gains are not declared false.
limitations: P1 — Unseen-website test domains were used in SFT — Counterevidence: Unseen by the later RL stage is a legitimate narrower meaning; held-out instructions and gains relative to SFT may survive. Disclosure is explicit.
P2 — Reported gains and weighted means disagree with tables/counts — Counterevidence: Different denominators/windows could explain weighted means but are not specified; direction of gains survives.

P3 — Release replay, shortest-success filtering and normalized token loss differ from exact on-policy identity — Counterevidence: Fresh success cloning gradient is valid up to positive scale; Alg1 explicitly accumulates D; replay may help empirically. Release configurations may be examples.

P4 — Released evaluator drops remainder tasks and randomizes index zero — Counterevidence: Alternative launchers/historicalcode not established; evaluation trajectories stored separately from training.
P5 — Whole-response substring parser differs from final-verdict semantics — Counterevidence: Ordinary canonical strings correctly parsed; historical incidence unknown.
N1 — Uncertainty, evaluator calibration and stage-specific autonomy — Counterevidence: Human7Bgain12.5to26; functional WebArena verification; relevant ablations and explicit appendix disclosures.
